results.title: Loom is rated "Bad" with 1.4 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
Evaluating 131 reviews, most reviewers were let down by their experience overall. People frequently mentioned that the application is extremely slow, constantly crashes during use, and suffers from frustrating login authentication issues along with unexpected software bugs. Customers also complained heavily about unexpected monthly subscription charges, incredibly difficult account cancellation pr ocesses, and unhelpful support policies that left them feeling trapped. Though some reviewers found the tool generally useful for recording quick professional explanations and saving valuable time during daily work tasks. The worst part about being a software developer is dealing with bugs. I can lock in and build for hours, but one bug can completely kill my momentum. That is why I started using Atlassian Loom. It turned a frustrating process into something fast and structured. 1. Record Instead of trying to explain the issue, I just record it. Loom captures everything in one go including my screen, console logs, network activity, and device info. No more guessing or missing details. 2.
